text_block_list.text:
Even with the Japan Cup right around the 
corner... the shock of Orfevre's defeat in 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe still 
smoldered among the fans.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I still find myself thinking about it, 
y'know... Why did she lose... Orfevre...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I was screaming at the top of my lungs in 
front of the TV... I was so sure they had 
it in the bag!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She was the strongest that day, after all. 
But to lose like that...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—It's as if Japanese Umamusume are under a 
curse that keeps them from winning...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —A policy address, is it?

Finishing 2nd in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe is an amazing result. No one 
doubts Orfevre's strength. Yet, for her, 
it is not enough.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
To be praised this much, even in 2nd 
place...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That distant land... has become far too 
distant.

In today's Japan Cup, she shouldn't be 
greeted with warmth. —She should be 
praised with respect and awe.
choice_data_list:
Let us remind them once more who the true 
king is.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You've gotten quite cheeky.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "I care not. —Do it."

Despite the press conference being called 
on short notice, numerous journalists and 
officials gathered. The reason was—not 
just Orfevre.
Because today's race is a special one.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the purpose of that sudden press 
conference... Was it truly out of your 
enthusiasm for the showdown with her?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Orfevre VS Gentildonna!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Heh— Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohohoho...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Have you come to understand now? My 
strength—this magnificent power of mine.

Gentildonna—the Umamusume who conquered 
the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba, and Shuka Sho 
this year to become a Triple Tiara 
Umamusume.

After demonstrating overwhelming strength 
in the Triple Tiara route—the counterpart 
to the Classic Triple Crown—she is now 
charging into the Japan Cup, where the 
fiercest veterans of the Senior Year 
gather.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A showdown between a Classic Triple Crown 
Umamusume and a Triple Tiara Umamusume is 
a historic first! Fan anticipation is 
running high!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Will the absolute monarchy continue?! —Or 
will the dawn of a new Queen's era begin?!

In her dream, after a fierce clash with 
Gentildonna... Orfevre suffered defeat by 
a mere nose.
choice_data_list:
(The same dream of defeat as the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe… but still)

text_block_list.text:
I won't back down this time. Together with 
Orfevre—I will seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
May we hear your thoughts and enthusiasm 
heading into this showdown of the century? 
—Orfevre-san!
choice_data_list: No, it doesn't matter who the opponent is.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list:
I believe Orfevre is the strongest in the 
world.

I believe that Orfe is the strongest in 
the world.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hear me, people of the realm. Do not lose 
your composure.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Kneel and await. The triumphant return of 
your king.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Answer me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What manner of running do you desire from 
your King?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What do you seek from me?

It's fine for her to be filled with rage. 
I know Orfevre better than anyone. She is 
at her strongest when she is free.
choice_data_list:
Let us show the people a grand dream once 
more!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Nay. They shall bear witness to the day it 
comes to pass. --In this unsetting gold.

—Clutching the gold pendant tightly. I 
won't pray anymore... My feelings are one 
with Orfevre.
(Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Oooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Japan Cup... What 
incredible fervor...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...All right! This officer shall give her 
greetings as well—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh dear....

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a letdown. Nothing but brittle 
stones...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It seems there is no one here capable of 
challenging me to my limits."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: !? Wh-Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Do you have the confidence to clash 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Are you the one trespassing upon my 
garden?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, well... The tyrant has made 
her appearance, hasn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Perhaps it would have been more 
appropriate to qualify that as "the other 
day's..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The outcome in that distant land was 
deeply regrettable to me as well. It is 
truly a pity... To think that you, too, 
could not escape the ordinary ways of this 
world.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how pitiful. You must still be so 
exhausted from the race... Truly admirable 
of you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Or did she rush out here... out of fear 
of being usurped, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Say, Orfe-san. Naturally... you will 
gladly make way for me, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I, this exquisite lady, shall graciously 
take my place upon your throne.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —How pathetic. Didn't you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You are in the King's presence. Do not 
ring. Do not laugh. —Do not interfere.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Pebbles have no place in my path.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Prostrate yourself before me—little girl!
